name: CardSwap-TS-TW
title: CardSwap
blurb: Cards cycle through a 3D stack with perspective transform and skew.
description: Wraps Card children; cycles them through a 3D stack with configurable timing. Cards rotate and skew as they move through positions. Pauses on hover. Uses GSAP for 3D transforms.
use_when: Testimonials, feature highlights, or rotating card stacks.
avoid_when: Browsers without 3D CSS support; older IE versions.
a11y: Cards are divs; children are accessible but sequence is visual. No keyboard navigation.
